newsitem.title: USA: STB Systems files for 1.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: STB Systems files for 1.8 mln shares.

text.p: STB Systems Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.8 million common shares.
Of the total, 1.5 million will be sold by the company and 300,000 common shares by certain selling shareholders, the filing said. After the offering, there will be 6,011,368 common shares.
The selling shareholders have granted the underwriters an over-allotment option of up to 270,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Hambrecht & Quist and Cowen & Co.
The company will used the proceeds to reduce bank indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
The Richardson, Tx-based company designs, manufactures and sell graphics adapters and other multimedia subsystem products for use primarily in desktop personal computers.
